idea: Orbit Protocol digitizes traditional informal rotating savings and credit associations (Ajo, Tandas, Susu, Chit Funds) used by over 1 billion people globally. We eliminate organizer theft through non-custodial smart contract escrow on NEAR, solve early-recipient ghosting with (N - 1) × C anti-ghosting collateral staking and automatic slashing, allow permissionless turn settlements via autonomous keeper agents, and convert lifelong savings disciplines into verifiable on-chain Soulbound reputation credentials.
